venue_note: Venue criteria (OSDI, SOSP, NSDI, SIGCOMM, EuroSys, ...) must be supplied via rubric.source_file.

criteria.name: Model fidelity
criteria.description: The formal/problem model matches the implemented system and its decisions.

criteria.name: Evaluation realism
criteria.description: Workloads, testbeds and baselines reflect the claimed deployment setting.

checks.name: Model vs. executable decisions
checks.name_zh: 问题模型与可执行决策一致
questions: Can the decisions in the formulation actually be executed by the system (information available at decision time, control knobs that exist)?
Is the temporal order of observation, decision and effect consistent (no use of future information)?

checks.name: Resource conservation and feasibility
checks.name_zh: 资源守恒与约束可行性
questions: Do capacity, bandwidth, energy or queue constraints conserve resources? Can the constraint set be infeasible for stated parameters?
Is complexity expressed in the true input size (e.g. numbers encoded in binary, number of flows/nodes)?
must_not: Non-convexity or integer variables alone do not prove NP-hardness.

checks.name: Workload and testbed realism
checks.name_zh: 负载与测试平台真实性
questions: Are workloads/traces, scale, hardware and network conditions representative of the claimed setting? Are simulation-only results generalised to deployment?

checks.name: Baseline configuration
questions: Are baseline systems configured and tuned reasonably (versions, parameters, same hardware)?

checks.name: Overheads and tail behaviour
questions: Are overheads (CPU, memory, control traffic), tail latency (p99/p999), failure and recovery behaviour measured, not only averages?
